title: Honeyed Thai Nectarine Pad Thai
description: A sweet and savory pad thai with juicy nectarines, tangy lime, and a honey glaze, cooked on a raclette grill for a melt-in-your-mouth texture.
instructions: Soak rice noodles in warm water for 15 minutes, then drain.
Heat coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat, add tofu cubes, and sauté until golden, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk tamarind paste, apple cider vinegar, honey, ground ginger, and minced garlic to create a sauce.
Add the sauce to the skillet with tofu, stir to coat, and cook for 2 minutes.
Spread the soaked noodles onto the heated raclette grill plate and toast until slightly crisp, about 2 minutes.
Scatter the nectarine wedges and sautéed tofu over the noodles, then pour the remaining sauce evenly.
Grill everything together on the raclette grill, flipping once, until the nectarines soften and the sauce thickens, about 3 minutes.
Garnish with sliced green onions and toasted crushed peanuts before serving.
